basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre of Excellence for Indian Knowledge Systems at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has one Project Research Assistant - Research post in the project "Vakyapadiya-tattva-patha-darsika A Systems Approach to the Dynamic and Digital Concept-Map of Vakyapadiyam" (Project Code – R/VDC), sponsored by Central Sanskrit University. Consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, the tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and applications are online until 31 December 2026. The application fee is Rs. 0 for all categories.

age_limit.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

The application fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST. content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The assignment is a temporary post in a purely time-bound research project undertaken in the Centre of Excellence for Indian Knowledge Systems of IIT Kharagpur, Kharagpur – 721 302. The project is led by Prof./Dr. Jayashree Aanand Gajjam as PI/Co-PI. Central Sanskrit University is the Sponsoring Agency.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for Project Research Assistant - Research is any one of the following routes: BE / B.Tech / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree; OR B.Sc./B.A./B.Com or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience; OR 3-year Diploma with 5 years of relevant experience; OR In exceptional cases, ITI (2-year course) in a trade with more than 8 years of relevant experience may be considered with prior approval and justification. A skill test will be required. Desirable: Knowledge of Computer applications, Secretarial experience for Technical and Ministerial. The notice lists under "Who is eligible" that applicants should possess a Masters degree/Acharya in Sanskrit or an allied discipline, preferably with a specialisation in Sanskrit Grammar, Indian Linguistics or Sanskrit Computational Linguistics. Candidates from technology and computational backgrounds may also apply, provided they have a strong foundation in Sanskrit Computational Linguistics and the ability to engage with original Sanskrit grammatical texts. Ability to read, understand and interpret original Sanskrit grammatical and philosophical texts. Good proficiency in written and spoken English. Familiarity with spreadsheets, digital research tools, AI-assisted tools and relevant software. An aptitude for interdisciplinary research, conceptual organisation and systematic documentation. Good communication skills, research aptitude and academic integrity. Interest in knowledge representation, knowledge graphs, digital humanities and computational approaches to language will be an added advantage. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is temporary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Research Assistant - Research
content_sections.text: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore; West Bengal-721302 Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account no.: 39502115210 IFSC code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT code: SBININBB339

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says that the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. A skill test is required for ITI candidates considered in exceptional cases. The notice does not give an interview date or mode.
